entries.source:
धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः ।
मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय ॥
entries.canonical: Darmakzetre kurukzetre samavetA yuyutsavaH | mAmakAH pARqavAScEva kimakurvata saYjaya ||
entries.baseline_mapping: dʰaɾmakʂeːtɾeː kuɾukʂeːtɾeː samaʋeːtaː jujutsaʋah, maːmakaːh paːɳɖaʋaːʃcaɪʋa kimakuɾʋata saɲɟaja.
entries.candidate_mapping: dʰaɾmakʂeːtɾeː kuɾukʂeːtɾeː samaʋeːtaː jujutsaʋah, maːmakaːh paːɳɖaʋaːʃcaɪʋa kimakuɾʋata saɲɟaja.
warnings: KOKORO_APPROXIMATED_VISARGA: ḥ → h (the traditional echo vowel is unspellable in Kokoro; h alone avoids a spurious syllable)
KOKORO_APPROXIMATED_VISARGA: ḥ → h (word-internal visarga; Kokoro has no voiceless fricative for it)

entries.source:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन ।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ॥

entries.source:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत ।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ॥
entries.canonical: yadA yadA hi Darmasya glAnirBavati BArata | aByutTAnamaDarmasya tadAtmAnaM sfjAmyaham ||
entries.baseline_mapping: jadaː jadaː hi dʰaɾmasja ɡlaːniɾbʰaʋati bʰaːɾata, abʰjuttʰaːnamadʰaɾmasja tadaːtmaːnã sɾɪɟaːmjaham.
entries.candidate_mapping: jadaː jadaː hi dʰaɾmasja ɡlaːniɾbʰaʋati bʰaːɾata, abʰjuttʰaːnamadʰaɾmasja tadaːtmaːnã sɾɪɟaːmjaham.
warnings: KOKORO_APPROXIMATION: anusvāra before a continuant → vowel nasalisation (Kokoro cannot spell a nasalised approximant)
KOKORO_APPROXIMATION: vocalic ṛ (ऋ) → ɾɪ (no syllabic diacritic in the Kokoro vocabulary)
